facts.fact: The Programme d'Action du Gouvernement project sheet lists the high and very high speed internet deployment (phase 2) as a government project, status 'En cours', execution period 2022-2026, to bring broadband to the whole national territory, with an expected backbone capacity extension at 8 sites from 40 to 100 Gbps; the sheet carries no date, so 2022 is the start of the stated period.
facts.system: Déploiement de l'Internet Haut et Très Haut Débit sur l'ensemble du territoire national (phase 2)

note: Project sheet of the government action programme; sheet is undated, as_of is the start of its stated period.
